name: rate-limit-guard
description: Stops Claude from hammering external APIs with curl loops.

maxCalls.title: Calls per window
maxCalls.description: How many curl, wget or httpie calls to one external host are allowed within the window before further calls are refused.

windowSec.title: Window (seconds)
windowSec.description: The sliding window the calls are counted in. It is also how long a host stays paused once its limit is reached.
